title: Cost
description: Evidence bundle file .agent/runs/<TASK-ID>/cost.json (spec Appendix B, F.6 worker outputs). The spec names cost.json as a required evidence artifact and requires tracking verification cost per task (§9.5) but gives no literal field example; this shape generalizes the lifecycle-cost components enumerated in §7.2 (implementation + verification + reviews + retries + human correction) and is intentionally permissive beyond the required totals so a CLI implementation can add detail.

task.description: Task id this cost record belongs to.

attempt.description: Attempt number this record covers, bounded by budget.attempts (spec §6.1, §6.3).

total_dollars.description: Total spend for this attempt, counted against the task's budget.dollars (spec §6.1).

breakdown.description: Spend by lifecycle phase, mirroring the §7.2 routing-objective components (implementation, verification, reviews, retries, human correction).

tier.description: Capability tier resolved by the router (policies/models.yaml, spec §7, §7.3).
